negative_evidence.detail: The first integration-test create attempt returned HTTP 409 because concurrent workers advanced main between re-entry and write. The path was rechecked as absent and the write was retried from the new head.
GitHub Actions warned that actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-python@v5 target deprecated Node.js 20 metadata while the platform forced Node.js 24. The job still completed successfully.
